config.survivalassist.title: SurvivalAssist Settings
config.survivalassist.enableEggThrower: Egg thrower (throw all eggs at once)
config.survivalassist.enableMatureOnlyHa: Only harvest mature crops (immature crops can't be mined)
config.survivalassist.veinMinerMaxBlocks: Number of blocks mined in one chain when pressing the ` key (mines all when sufficient blocks exist)
config.survivalassist.healthBarWidth.too: Width of the health bar, larger value means longer bar
config.survivalassist.healthDisplayRange: Maximum distance to show health bars; entities beyond this distance are hidden
config.survivalassist.autoReplantDelay.t: Delay in ticks before replanting after harvesting, 0 = replant immediately
config.survivalassist.eggThrowInterval.t: Ticks between each egg throw, 0 = fastest
config.survivalassist.gamma.tooltip: Overall game brightness. 0~100 is vanilla brightness (100 = vanilla max), above 100 adds extra brightness, up to 1500
Select the enchant book to roll for, displayed as localized name
config.survivalassist.enchantBookTargetL: Target enchant book level, 0 means any level counts as a hit
config.survivalassist.enchantBookMaxLeve: Upper bound of the target level slider range
config.survivalassist.enchantBookMaxRoun: Stop after this many failed rounds, 0 = never stop
config.survivalassist.autoMineRange.tool: Maximum distance to auto-find ores, larger means farther scan
config.survivalassist.xrayRange.tooltip: Range of X-Ray ore rendering, larger means farther view
config.survivalassist.customOreList.tool: Enter block IDs (e.g. minecraft:stone), comma-separated; modded blocks supported
Auto exit server when health drops below this percentage
config.survivalassist.exitPickaxePercent: Auto exit server when main-hand pickaxe durability drops below this percentage
